conventions.phase: arg(S), principal value in (-180, 180] deg; a delay is a negative phase
conventions.s_matrix: 4x4 [[S11, S12], [S21, S22]] over (port1 x, port1 y, port2 x, port2 y); entry name S<out><in>_<received><incident>; port 1 = top reference plane (wave incident travelling -z), port 2 = bottom reference plane (wave incident travelling +z)
conventions.linear_basis: global x and y unit vectors, identical at both ports

circular_basis.rotation_in_time: R rotates clockwise seen from +z (x toward -y); L counter-clockwise
circular_basis.handedness: right-hand rule, thumb along propagation: R is RHCP when travelling -z and LHCP when travelling +z; L is the reverse
circular_basis.components: S<out><in>_<received><incident> with labels R/L, e.g. S21_LR
circular_basis.transform: S_circ = T^H S_lin T, T = [e_R e_L] (unitary)
